title: OpEnvelope
description: The canonical append-only operation record written to a model/ops/ segment (one canonical-JSON object per line). The discriminator is the stable kebab-case `kind` name; the typed `payload` object conforms to the matching per-kind schema in this directory. Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile (docs/04-contracts/canonical-json.md): keys sorted by UTF-8 byte order, all fields present, absent optionals as null, HLC/full-range coordinates as decimal strings. The u16 op code lives only in the registry and SQLite projection, never in the record (ADR-0038).

op_id.description: Permanent identity of this one append; minted once on the authoring path and preserved verbatim across replay, package, and rebuild. With partition_id it forms the (partition_id, op_id) identity.

actor_id.description: Who or what asserted the operation; drives content classification.

asserted_at.description: Hybrid logical clock (full-range packed i64) encoded as a decimal string per the canonical-JSON profile, never a JSON number.

kind.description: Stable kebab-case operation discriminator. The portable contract name; the u16 code is registry-only and never appears in the record.

format_version.description: Canonical-JSON profile / record format version. A bump is a refuse-or-degrade event, never a silent change (ADR-0002, ADR-0038).

deps.description: Causal dependencies, by op_id ([] when none). An operation whose predecessor is absent is reported on import, not applied blind.

payload.description: Typed payload object for this kind, conforming to the matching docs/contracts/operations/<kind>.schema.json. Not opaque bytes and not base64 — opaque bytes may persist only as a validated cache of these canonical bytes, never as the contract.

id.description: An Id serialised as a canonical UUID string (lower-case, hyphenated). ULID input is accepted on parse but normalised to lower-case UUID before append.

hlc.description: Full-range 64-bit coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile). The in-memory representation remains i64.
